card.name: Start of words with con- inside
card.fires_on: The first piece of a longer word just before an 'on'/'con' piece, mostly 'ant' before 'iconvulsant', also 'c' in 'itraconazole' and 'cements', or 'Rec' before 'onstituted'.

modes.label: Anti-convulsant
modes.description: The 'ant' piece at the start of 'anticonvulsant' or 'anticonformity'.
modes.example: control of convulsions with standard<< ant>>iconvulsant agents.

modes.label: Other con- words
modes.description: A single letter or short piece right before 'onazole', 'oncements' or 'onstituted' style endings.

card.writes: It promotes 'on' endings and suppresses 'kon'/'Con' spellings, pushing the next piece to be 'on'.
card.plain: It fires on the opening piece of words like anticonvulsant, where the next piece is 'on'.
